warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-2'-3-4-5-6-7 at 2.00 + 1.50 + 0.50 + 1.00 + 0.83 + 2.67 + 3.50 (12.00); y = A-B-C-D-E-F-G at 3.50 + 2.67 + 0.83 + 1.00 + 2.00 + 2.00 (12.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04 and on the A-07/A-08 building sections. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page; positions were cross-checked against the vector geometry (footing caps, column squares, beam outlines, grid bubbles all land on these pos_m within 0.01 m).
Grid 2' is a printed bubble (named line), not a dummy — it is drawn raised above the 1..7 bubble row on every plan sheet. No dummy falls between 2 and 3, so no rule name collides with it.

Dummy lines come from three sources: S-01/S-02 (A' -1.50 porch row, A''' 2.00, B'' 5.60, 5' 6.85, 6' 9.90 — beam lines), S-03/S-04 (A'' 1.75, B' 5.00, C' 6.50, D' 7.91, 3' 4.09, 4' 5.50, 5'' 7.00, 6'' 10.25 — roof post and truss lines). Every printed tick became a line (section 4 rule 4). Close pairs kept apart because they are different printed points: A'' 1.75 vs A''' 2.00 (0.25), 5' 6.85 vs 5'' 7.00 (0.15), 6' 9.90 vs 6'' 10.25 (0.35).

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนน (A-07/A-08, and the A-01 notes). Two levels carry the same printed label 'ระดับหลังอกไก่' (+5.28 and +7.14), so their ids carry the printed value as well. ระดับดินเดิม (S-06 footing details) prints no value: kept with level_m null; the 1.00 / 0.50 / 0.05 / 0.05 footing depths stay on the footing elements (S-06 file), not as z ticks.

Dimension sweep covers the structural plans S-01..S-04 plus the building sections A-07/A-08 (grid chains + levels). S-05 truss panel chains (T1 1.58 | 1.14 x3 | 1.17 x3 | 0.90 x2, T2 1.06 x2 | 0.99 x5) are printed with no grid markers, so they stay on the truss elements as element-internal dimensions (rule 4, 'not an axis tick'). S-06..S-08 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes, section sizes, slab/stair thicknesses), which stay on their elements. The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03..A-06, A-09..A-11, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run, and the room tags on A-07/A-08 are not recorded.
The GS slab outside grid 7 (rows A-B) and the roof eave/overhang outline on S-03/S-04 carry no printed dimension on the swept sheets — no line was invented for them.
